Private League Access

Only needed if your league is set to private on ESPN. Paste two values from your own logged-in browser and every fetch reads your league as you. They stay in this browser as a fallback, and member saves store only an AES-256 encrypted copy — never the raw values.

▶Where do I find these two values?

These are called espn_s2 and SWID — two harmless ID tokens ESPN already stored in your browser when you logged in. You're just copying them across.

  1. On a computer, open your ESPN Fantasy league while logged in.
  2. Press F12 (or right-click → Inspect).
  3. Open the Application tab → Cookies → fantasy.espn.com.
  4. Copy the value next to espn_s2, then SWID, and paste each below.

Historical Archive & Record Book

🏆 Unlock your league's 10-year history & all-time records One-time upload lights up the Record Book, Rivalry Vault, and every all-time leaderboard. Only one manager in the league ever needs to do this — everyone else loads it automatically by League ID.

WHAT IS LUCK DIFFERENTIAL?

Decision Science · Transparency

How the FSN Power Index Works

FSN Index = 0.50·All-Play% + 0.20·PFnorm + 0.15·CFadj + 0.15·Context

A single 0–100 read on roster quality · Higher is better

1 · All-Play Win % 50%

Schedule-neutral win rate. Every week your score is run head-to-head against every other team in the league, then total all-play wins ÷ total all-play matchups × 100. It strips away who you happened to be scheduled against.

2 · Scoring Dominance 20%

Your points-per-game measured against the league ceiling: PPG ÷ league-max PPG × 100. The hottest offense in the league sets 100; everyone else is scored relative to it.

3 · Consistency 15%

Week-to-week stability from the coefficient of variation, CV = s ÷ μ, scored as (1 − CV) × 100 — a steadier floor rates higher. Before four scored weeks the value is shrunk toward the league median so a tiny sample can't overrate a team.

4 · Roster Context 15%

Managerial efficiency — the share of your optimal lineup you actually started (Optimal Start %). When the platform doesn't expose bench points (a common ESPN export limit), this pillar safely falls back to normalized Schedule Hardship / Strength of Schedule instead.

How do I connect my league?

No tech background needed. Start with Step 1. Public leagues need only the League ID; private leagues also need Step 2. Step 3 is only for the all-time Record Book.

1

Find your League ID

Your League ID is a number ESPN gives your league. There are two easy ways to find it:

On a computer (web browser): Log in to your ESPN Fantasy league and open your league page. Look at your browser's address bar at the top — you'll see a web address containing leagueId=57155288. The number right after leagueId= is your League ID.

On the ESPN mobile app: Open your league, then tap League → League Info → League ID. The number shown there is your League ID.

Type just that number into the League ID box on the Setup screen and tap Fetch League Data.

If your league loads, you're done — it's a public league and you can skip Steps 2 and 3.
2

Private league? Get your cookies

If fetching fails with a "private league" message, ESPN needs to know it's really you. You'll copy two secret values (called espn_s2 and SWID) from your own browser.

  1. On a computer, open your ESPN Fantasy league page in Google Chrome or Safari while logged in.
  2. Press F12 (or right-click the page and choose Inspect) to open the developer panel.
  3. In that panel, open the Application tab (Chrome) or the Storage tab (Safari).
  4. On the left sidebar, expand Cookies and click https://fantasy.espn.com.
  5. In the list, find the rows named espn_s2 and SWID.
  6. Copy each long value and paste it into the matching Private League Access box on the Setup screen.
Paste each value exactly as your browser gives it — the app cleans it up for you. A copied SWID= or espn_s2= prefix, surrounding quotes, missing or percent-encoded curly braces { }, and the line breaks the cookie panel adds to long values are all handled automatically. Your cookies stay in this browser and are only sent to ESPN through the app's own secure relay.
3

Add historical stats (.json)

Want the all-time Record Book and Rivalry Vault? Save a one-time history file from ESPN and drop it in.

  1. On a computer, open your league's history web address in a new browser tab. Tip: enter your League ID on the Setup screen and use the ready-made history export URL shown in the Historical Archive panel.
  2. Press Ctrl+S (Windows) or Cmd+S (Mac) to save the page.
  3. When asked, save it as a .json file to somewhere easy like your Desktop.
  4. Back on the Setup screen, open Load Archive JSON and drag that .json file into the dropzone (or tap it to pick the file).
The moment it loads, the Record Book and Rivalry Vault unlock. Any authenticated league member — not just the commissioner — can save the archive plus an encrypted cookie envelope to the league's Supabase record. Teammates can then load by League ID without receiving the raw credentials.
